about.never: Your first Java program! The line that prints is already written but switched off with `//`. You switch it on, add your name, and run it.
about.bit: A first Java program: uncomment the println line, add your name, run it.
about.lot: Uncomment the `println` in `Main`, replace `YOUR NAME`, run, verify.

why.never: The checker runs your program and looks for `Hello, World! My name is` followed by your name. A line that starts with `//` is a **comment**: Java skips it, so it prints nothing until you delete the `//`.
why.lot: Output must contain `Hello, World! My name is <name>`, with `YOUR NAME` replaced.

hints.never: Open `src/Main.java`. Find the line that starts with `// System.out.println`. The `//` at the front turns it off.
Delete the two slashes `//` at the start of that line, then change `YOUR NAME` to your actual name. Keep the quote marks.
hints.bit: Delete the `//`, then replace `YOUR NAME` with your name.

hints.never: The line should look like `System.out.println("Hello, World! My name is Sam");` with your name instead of Sam. Save with **Ctrl+S**, click **Run** (▷), then **Verify**.
hints.bit: `System.out.println("Hello, World! My name is Sam");` (your name), then save, Run, Verify.
